# How Big Is the ANTISCAM Dataset? Scale, Composition, and Source Reliability

## Introduction

The ANTISCAM dataset is a corpus of human–human anti-scam dialogs introduced to support research on non-collaborative dialog systems—conversational settings in which the user and the system do not share a common goal ([Li et al., 2020](document_1.txt)).
